newsitem.title: USA: Newmont says Santa Fe silent on bid.
newsitem.headline: Newmont says Santa Fe silent on bid.

text.p: Newont Mining Corp said Thursday it has not yet received a response to its unsolicited, proposed stock-swap takeover of Santa Fe Pacific Gold Corp, delivered to the Santa Fe directors this morning.
A spokesman for Newmont also said Newmont had been in talks with Santa Fe "from time time" but declined to elaborate.
Terms of the proposal call for a share exchange at a ratio of 0.33 Newmont shares for each Santa Fe shares, a transaction that Newmont valued at more than $2 billion.
The spokesman would only add that the coversations were undertaken in the course of the companies' common business.
A second Newmont spokesman said, "Our interest in the company is well-established over a long period. We have looked at it rather closely."
In dollars, the terms value Santa Fe shares at $16 each based on market prices before the news forced a halt in share trading.
Newmont was up 1 to 48-1/2 on the New York Stock Exchange before the halt, while Santa Fe was at 13-3/8, up 1-1/2.
After trading resumed, Newmont was off 1/8 to 47-3/8, while Santa Fe added 2-7/8 to 14-3/4.
